note: Single source for how each data feed and each scheduled task reaches the repo: route, cadence, how lateness is detected and the fallback. RUNBOOK, CURRENT-STATE and the task prompts point here instead of restating routes. A PR that changes a route edits this file in the same PR (PR template checkbox). Reference data, not coaching instructions.

written_in_sessions.note: Athlete files no feed or task writes on a schedule: changed only in a session the athlete starts (a project thread, a reply to the check-in) or by a reviewed PR. Every tracked athlete file under coach/ and state/ is named under a path's writes or here (coach/tests/test_data_paths_writers.py, 6.61.0), so a new file cannot appear without a stated writer.

written_by_outside_tasks.note: Athlete files a scheduled task outside this repo's routes writes (see consumers_outside_repo).

paths.route: GitHub Actions pull-garmin.yml: four cron pulls a day (UTC 10:23, 11:23, 16:23, 23:23) that in practice land 5 to 10 h late (Oct 23 to Nov 3, 2026), plus the morning check-in's own workflow_dispatch, which lands in about a minute; an on-request dispatch during the day is followed by a dashboard refresh (RUNBOOK, On-request refresh); hilly runs and hikes also get a 5 s detail stream (scripts/streams.py, Nov 8, 2026), and a stream that fails to land is flagged in that morning's check-in (morning_facts freshness)
paths.fallback: the check-in dispatches again once after about 4 minutes with nothing landed (RUNBOOK Data 3, Second try, 6.27.1); if nothing lands, it runs on the data on hand and says so. The four crons stay as the backstop for a day when no Claude task runs

paths.what: Hume scale weight and body fat % (lean mass Calculated)
paths.route: Hume app writes Apple Health; iPhone Shortcut 'Send scale to coach' runs on its own from personal automations at 9:00 AM and 8:00 PM (built and working Nov 3, 2026), repository_dispatch body_comp, ingest-body-comp.yml
paths.cadence: twice daily send; weigh-ins when the athlete steps on the scale
paths.late_means: no new weigh-in has reached the repo in 48 h: either no weigh-in (travel) or the Shortcut stopped (received_utc moves only when a value changes, so a send with nothing new leaves no trace)
paths.fallback: weigh in, then if nothing lands by the next automation, open the Shortcut once by hand; the manual send from a Claude chat on the iPhone (coach/ops/APPLE-HEALTH-SEND.md) is the last resort

paths.what: Daily Fitness Coach check-in (scheduled task outside the project, 7:45 AM ET)
paths.route: scheduled task (task id); its short prompt reads coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-morning.md from the repo at each run (from Nov 2026, week 3), so edit that file, not the task; steps coach/ops/RUNBOOK.md
paths.fallback: the same day: from 9:41 AM ET the dashboard Today card turns its Out of date banner into a red Missed line when there is no check-in for today (app.js renderToday, 6.27.1; it needs no task, so it also works on a day no Claude task runs); the next run notices the missing day and says so in its last line

paths.what: Race calendar watch (project routine, Sundays 5:27 AM ET, silent)
paths.route: project scheduled task (task id) (recreated Nov 5, 2026); its prompt reads coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-weekly.md from the repo at each run, so edit that file, not the task. The Oct 19 task (task id) is switched off (its stored text had drifted from the file)
paths.fallback: run the task by hand from the Coach project

paths.what: Monthly research scan (project routine, 1st of the month 4:53 AM ET, silent)
paths.route: scheduled task (task id), prompt coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-research.md, method coach/research/PROTOCOL.md
paths.fallback: run the task by hand from the Coach project

paths.what: Project Board handoffs from other projects (shared board, read by the morning run)
paths.route: the morning check-in reads the board (link and name in coach/board.json, which only the original athlete's repo has) at RUNBOOK Data 4b, files accepted items in CURRENT-STATE or BACKLOG, and stamps coach/board.json with coach/tools/board.py; lab and appointment handoffs go out to Admin the same way (RUNBOOK Send)
paths.fallback: read the board by hand in a Coach thread (RUNBOOK Data 4b); Admin's daily refresh also lists items left new for more than 48 hours

paths.what: Daytime dashboard refresh (scheduled task, every 2 hours 9:41 AM to 9:41 PM ET; the athlete chose it Nov 11, 2026, roadmap week 4); the dashboard's top icon (fresh.js) shows its next run time
paths.route: a fresh-session scheduled task whose short prompt reads coach/ops/TASK-PROMPT-refresh.md: dispatches pull-garmin.yml, waits, and only when coach/tools/refresh_check.py finds an activity the dashboard has not shown, rebuilds coach.json and republishes the three datasets (RUNBOOK Publish 2 and 3); the 7:45 run marks the same record
paths.cadence: every 2 hours 9:41 AM to 9:41 PM ET, and the 7:45 run
paths.fallback: the 7:45 run republishes every morning; a thread can follow TASK-PROMPT-refresh.md on demand

paths.what: GitHub hiccup log: Actions stalls (startup failures, runs stuck in the queue) and late or missed timed pulls, with three levels for telling the athlete (the athlete chose them Nov 12, 2026)
paths.route: the daytime refresh (TASK-PROMPT-refresh.md step 0) and the 7:45 run (RUNBOOK Data 2a) list recent workflow runs with the GitHub tool and run coach/tools/hiccups.py scan; precheck skips a pull while GitHub is stuck; the 7:45 run adds the status line to the check-in and, at level 3, writes the ticket draft and a BACKLOG line
paths.cadence: every daytime refresh and the 7:45 run
paths.fallback: nothing is lost: the next run scans the last 50 runs again; a thread can run the scan on demand

paths.what: Morning feel answers (dashboard form or chat)
paths.route: dashboard store feel_daily, copied by the morning run (RUNBOOK Data 4)

paths.what: Lifted yesterday? tap (Today card, the morning after a planned lift with nothing logged)
paths.route: dashboard store lift_tap, copied by the morning run (RUNBOOK Data 4)
paths.cadence: the morning after a planned, unlogged lift

paths.what: Today changed? tap (Today plan card: reason, optional line, Do the Min size today), or a day-of change told in chat
paths.route: dashboard store day_change, copied by the daytime refresh and the morning run with day_change.py ingest (RUNBOOK Data 4, Today changed); chat: day_change.py add
paths.cadence: on a day the plan changes
paths.fallback: the plan stands until the next session that hears of the change

paths.what: Check-in settings (Check-ins tab, When your coach checks in: on or off, a time, Add a check-in), or a change told in chat
paths.route: dashboard store checkin_task, copied by every check-in with checkin_tasks.py ingest (RUNBOOK Check-in settings); chat: checkin_tasks.py set or add
paths.fallback: every check-in runs at the time its scheduled task has

paths.route: dashboard store lift_log, ingested by lifts.py in the morning run

paths.what: Trips and time away on the athlete's Google Calendar (read only, next 7 days)
paths.route: the morning run reads the calendar connector itself (RUNBOOK Data 4c, coach/tools/trips.py, 6.75.0); the events file stays outside the repo; coach/trips_seen.json keeps only hashed keys and dates of trips already asked about
paths.fallback: a missed read is a skipped step in coach/run_steps.json; the athlete telling a thread about a trip still reaches the plan

paths.route: dashboard store checkin, ingested by checkins.py in the morning run

paths.what: Home blood pressure readings (A&D cuff photos)
paths.route: the athlete posts cuff photos in the Coach project with no text; the receiving thread logs them by the rules in coach/ops/HOME-BP.md without asking, via a small PR
writes: coach/health.json (lab bp_sys / bp_dia rows with time and part)
paths.fallback: the twice-yearly home BP week survey on the Check-ins tab

paths.what: Block brief decision (Fitness tab, This block card, Next option)
paths.route: dashboard store brief_choice, recorded by brief.py accept or change in the morning run (RUNBOOK Data 4)
paths.cadence: once per block, while a brief is proposed
paths.fallback: unanswered by decide_by, the brief goes live as proposed (engine/BLOCK-BRIEF.md section 2)

consumers_outside_repo: Admin project reads race date notices (Project Board msgs, type notice, from Coach) for logistics, calendar and pet cover; names, dates and places only (coach/tools/board_jobs.py race-notices, RUNBOOK Data 4b)

Life board secretary (Admin's board pack task, 1st, 7th and 15th) reads the Project Board reports/YYYY-MM-Coach, filed by the 6th; colors and words only (coach/tools/board_jobs.py report-draft and report-check)

Sunday mentor review task ((task id)) reads coach.json rows summary (from 6.12.0), today, week and marker from the dashboard store; the fields it may rely on are in coach/ops/contract.json, who reads what in coach/connections.json, and coach/tests/test_contract.py guards them

Chef project (meal planner) reads coach.json meal_guide rows, today and 13 days ahead, with planned minutes, time of day and the extras from coach/nutrition_extras.json, from the dashboard store (week 3 PR 2); fields in coach/ops/contract.json, guarded by coach/tests/test_meal_guide.py
Gmail triage task ((task id)) watches race registration mail; it does not write to the repo
Used bike deal watch ((task id)) writes coach/bike-watch.md only

watch.note: Scheduled tasks outside the repo's files that the coach feeds or depends on (Closed loops, the athlete's pick option 1, Nov 15, 2026). The morning run reads each by id only (never the whole task list: other projects' instructions are private) and coach/tools/task_watch.py names a late, failed or switched off one on the check-in's last line (RUNBOOK Send). The daytime refresh is not here: its file heartbeat (daytime_refresh) already covers it. grace_hours: how long after a due time before it counts as late.
